term: unique anchor reason with cross-world overlap
definition: AnchorOverlap means there is a world a where x exists, exactly one admitted reason r at a, and for every world v where x exists there is some token admitted at both a and v. Overlap witnesses may vary until anchor uniqueness identifies them. Nonvacuity, uniqueness and overlap are explicit conditional assumptions, not consequences of PSR.
